principle: Automation Layer and disput/ are separate orchestration domains. disput/ is not a drop-in execution engine for Product→Architecture Framework.
may_reuse_via_explicit_adapter: generic restart/recovery utilities that do not own Product→Architecture canonical state
must_not_reuse_as_authority: disput artifact model as Product→Architecture Registry schema
disput commit semantics as a substitute for AL StateCommitter
integration_rule: Any reused module must cross a narrow adapter whose output matches Automation Layer contracts; no shared mutable canonical state between debate and Product→Architecture runtimes.
reason: Avoid dual schedulers, vocabulary leakage and two competing commit/state machines.
